shadow_evaluation_design.title: Mathiyon SLM v1.3 Isolated Controlled Shadow Evaluation Architecture

architecture_flow.step_1: User submits API request to POST /api/chat or POST /generate.
architecture_flow.step_2: Production backend routes request to Mathiyon SLM v1.2 (Production Model).
architecture_flow.step_3: Mathiyon SLM v1.2 processes request & returns response to User immediately (100% User Experience).
architecture_flow.step_4: In background (asynchronous non-blocking worker), request payload is copied to Shadow Evaluation Pipeline.
architecture_flow.step_5: Shadow Pipeline executes Mathiyon SLM v1.3 + KV Cache in isolated memory context.
architecture_flow.step_6: Shadow Pipeline logs comparison metrics to shadow_evaluation_logs DB table without modifying user response or database state.

security_and_privacy_controls: User Isolation: Shadow pipeline respects JWT authentication context and user permission scopes.
Data Privacy: PII, secret keys, and credentials scrubbed before shadow logging.
Non-Blocking: Asynchronous event loop execution ensures 0 ms added latency to production user response.
Zero Production Exposure: Shadow output NEVER returned to user or saved to user conversation history.

shadow_evaluation_success_criteria.user_impact: Zero (0 ms added latency, 0 UI changes)
